title: Web introduction Linux Operating System
description: A website that introduces the Linux Operating System, covering its fundamentals, distributions, features, and real-world usage. This project is designed to help beginners understand Linux concepts, command-line basics, and its role in servers, development, and cybersecurity through a clean, informative, and user-friendly interface.

title: Blynk-Based Glass Cleaning Robot
description: A robot that uses Blynk for remote control and monitoring. It features automatic cleaning, obstacle detection, and a user-friendly mobile app interface.

title: Newspaper Clippings Management System
description: A system for managing newspaper clippings with features for categorization, search, and archival.

title: Gallery Photo
description: A responsive photo gallery web application that allows users to upload, view, and manage their photo collections with features like categorization and search functionality.

title: Field work practice (PKL) attendance application
description: A web-based attendance application designed for managing and tracking student attendance during field work practice (PKL). The application allows students to log their attendance, view schedules, and receive notifications, while administrators can monitor attendance records and generate reports.

title: Website Portofolio Modern Version
description: A modern personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, and experiences with a sleek design and responsive layout.
